summary: Inserts a pointer into the next free slot of a growable pointer array. The array slot base is this[2] (offset +0x8) and the current element count is this[0] (offset +0x0). The caller's pointer is stored at slot this[0], the previous count value is written into the inserted node's first dword, and the count at this+0 is incremented. Returns the inserted pointer.

local_names.this: dynamic pointer-array object holding the current count (this[0], +0x0) and the slot base (this[2], +0x8)
local_names.a2: pointer to the node being inserted
local_names.result: the inserted node pointer, also the return value

operations.description: Compute the destination slot address as this[2] (offset +0x8) + 4 * this[0], where this[0] (offset +0x0) is the current element count
Store the caller's node pointer into the computed slot
Write the previous count value into the inserted node's first dword, linking the node to its slot index
Increment the element count at this+0 (post-increment on the index used for the slot)
Return the inserted node pointer; the insert is invoked by ShortComputation_f0d0

unresolved: No growth or capacity handling is present here; whether the slot array at this+0x8 is pre-allocated or resized by a separate path is not visible in this packet
The owner object providing this+0x0 and this+0x8 is unknown; its caller ShortComputation_f0d0 would need to be read to identify it
